material_systems.name: Oil-Based Penetrating Stain
products: General Finishes Oil Based Gel Stain
material_systems.notes: Traditional oil-based stain. Deep penetration, rich color. Longer dry time (4-8 hrs). Strong odor — ventilation required. Mineral spirits cleanup.

material_systems.name: Oil-Modified Stain (VOC-Compliant)
products: Sherwin-Williams Wood Classics Interior Oil Stain
material_systems.notes: VOC-compliant oil-modified formula. Similar penetration to traditional oil. Lower odor. Water cleanup.

material_systems.name: Water-Based Stain
products: General Finishes Water Based Wood Stain
material_systems.notes: Fast dry (1-2 hrs). Low odor. Water cleanup. Grain raise likely — conditional grain-raise prep task activated. Non-yellowing.

material_systems.name: Gel Stain
material_systems.notes: Gel formula sits on surface — does not penetrate deeply. Controls blotch on softwood without conditioner. QT4+ only (premium product).

material_systems.name: Oil-Based Sanding Sealer
material_systems.notes: Shellac-based sanding sealer. Excellent adhesion promoter between stain and clear. Sands easily. Fast dry (30-60 min).

material_systems.name: Water-Based Sanding Sealer
products: General Finishes Water Based Sanding Sealer
Target Coatings Water Based Sanding Sealer
material_systems.notes: Water-based sanding sealer. Low odor. Fast dry. Sands smoothly.

material_systems.name: Oil-Based Polyurethane
material_systems.notes: Traditional oil poly. Warm amber tone. Excellent durability. Longer dry time (4-6 hrs between coats).

material_systems.name: Water-Based Polyurethane
products: General Finishes High Performance Water Based Topcoat
material_systems.notes: Water-based poly. Crystal clear (no yellowing). Fast dry (2 hrs between coats). Low odor.

material_systems.name: Lacquer
products: Target Coatings EM6000 Water White Lacquer
material_systems.notes: Spray-only application. Fastest dry time (30-60 min between coats). Crystal clear. Requires proper ventilation.

coverage_profiles.notes: Stain brush on window surfaces — lower coverage than flat trim due to profile complexity and sash detail work.
Stain spray on window. Includes overspray waste. Still requires wipe step.
Sanding sealer — thin coat. Slightly lower than flat trim due to window profiles.
Clear coat brush on window. Profile complexity reduces coverage vs flat trim.
Clear coat spray on window. Some overspray waste on window profiles.

consumables.name: Sandpaper 120-grit
consumables.notes: 8 windows per sheet — sash profiles use sandpaper faster than flat trim.

consumables.name: Natural bristle brush (1.5" angled sash)
consumables.usage: Oil-based clear coat on window profiles

consumables.name: Tack cloth
consumables.usage: Remove sanding dust before each coat

consumables.name: Masking tape (1.5" blue painter's tape)
consumables.usage: Glass masking, wall masking, sill protection

consumables.name: Masking paper (12")
consumables.usage: Glass masking paper, wall masking for spray

glass_mask.description: Glass masking with tape and paper/film — mandatory
glass_mask.notes: Mandatory. Stain on glass is harder to remove than paint. Extra care required.

floor_below.description: Drop cloths below window work area
floor_below.notes: Stain drips are very difficult to clean from finished floors.

wall_adjacent_window.notes: Required for spray. Also when walls SS_PAINTED_* with any method.

hardware_covers.notes: Remove preferred — stain penetrates hardware finishes.

compatibility_rules.description: No chemistry-pairing constraints between stain and clear layers
compatibility_rules.notes: Oil stain under WB clear is standard practice. Only hard constraints are gel stain QT gate and lacquer spray-only.
Gel stain is a premium product. Blocked below QT4.
Lacquer dries too fast for brush application. Spray only.

material_notes.selection_guidance: Material systems are shared across all interior stain specs. Same 9 systems (4 stain, 2 sealer, 3 clear). Only 2 hard rules: gel stain requires QT4+, lacquer requires spray.
material_notes.stain_wipe_critical: ALL stain application methods include a wipe step. Wipe timing varies by stain type.
material_notes.window_specific: Use angled sash brush (1.5") for window profile detail work. Foam brush works for jamb areas.
